action.objective: Verify Kg8, the broad-search top candidate, with a single-candidate depth-4 search to establish safety and commit-readiness.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search (cutoff at 3000 nodes) scored Kg8 best at exact -584 with PV Kg8-Kd7-Kf8, and no refutations exist. commit_ready_moves is empty, so I must use the reserved 2000 nodes to verify only g7g8 before committing. In this lost rook-vs-king endgame, the aim is the best-measured defensive king placement, not rescue.
